Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Letter of Representation
30 Apr 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1206
Our client: Kathy Estes
Date of loss: 19 Mar 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
This office represents the claimant in connection with the parking lot collision
described in your insured's file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is
currently receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further
communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client
directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.
We ask that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in
force on the date of loss, along with a statement of the bodily injury and property
damage limits available under that policy, including any excess or umbrella coverage
your insured may hold.
We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This
includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle inspection reports,
repair estimates, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any electronic data from
the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of these
materials while the claim is open.
Kindly confirm receipt of this letter and your intent to comply with these requests
within fourteen days.
Sincerely,
Laura Bryant
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
